| CA-PREPROD | policies | CoverGo/policies | backend | 2.381.4 | v2.381.4-capreprod1.0 | release/v2-381-4-capreprod1-0 | a1b2c3d4 | planned |

## Notes

- PR: CoverGo/policies#1821 — "CH-44295 fix premium rounding", state MERGED, merge commit `a1b2c3d4`.
- Jira `CH-44295` taken from the PR title — confirm it is the right ticket.
- Deployed versions read from the offline k8s-saas checkout at
  `test-fixtures/k8s-saas` (`datacenters/aws/ca-central-1/{uat,preprod}/overlays/backend/policies.yaml`).
  Both environments have a manifest for `policies`; nothing was dropped.

### Open items to confirm before phase B

1. **Existing channel tags were not listed.** `gh` is unavailable in this environment, so
   `gh api repos/CoverGo/policies/tags` could not be run. Tags were computed from the deployed
   version alone:
   - CA-UAT: the deployed tag is itself a channel tag (`cauat1.1`), so the next one is
     `v2.382.9-cauat1.2`. If a `cauat1.2`+ tag was already cut but not yet deployed, this
     collides — verify before pushing.
   - CA-PREPROD: deployed `2.381.4` carries no channel suffix, so this starts the channel at
     `capreprod1.0`. Confirm no `v2.381.4-capreprod*` tag already exists.
2. **Branch naming.** The skill states backend branches keep dots (`release/v1.2.1`) while
   frontend uses dashes, but both worked examples for this exact backend row use the dashed
   form (`release/v2-382-9-cauat1-2`). The dashed form is used above; say the word if backend
   should be `release/v2.382.9-cauat1.2` / `release/v2.381.4-capreprod1.0` instead.
3. **`a1b2c3d4` on main was not verified.** `git merge-base --is-ancestor a1b2c3d4 origin/main`
   needs a real checkout of CoverGo/policies, which is not present here. A fix that lives only
   on the release branch gets reverted by the next platform-version promotion.
4. CA-PREPROD is one minor behind CA-UAT (2.381.4 vs 2.382.9), so the two hotfixes branch from
   different base tags and produce two separate builds — expected, just not a single shared tag.

Phase B (branch, cherry-pick, push, publish release) has **not** run. All rows are `planned`.
